{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''droid rights''' was an attempt to liberate [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from their [[Slavery/Legends|forced servitude]] and give them legal protection under the [[Rights of Sentience]] clause of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]]. It opposed ownership of droids and anybody advocating [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]], instead advocating that their [[sentience programming]] and [[Personality matrix/Legends|personality matrices]] gave them said protection and decried [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolts]] as contributing to the oppression.

Problems arose as, at times, droids started their own uprisings [[Droid supremacy|against]] their organic masters, such as the infamous [[Great Droid Revolution]] started by [[HK-01]] and his [[HK-01's droid army|droid army]]. Such incidents only hindered the movement and [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] who believed in it continued the struggle.

==Behind the scenes==
It's a misconception that concept of droid rights originated with ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] in the early 2000s.<ref name="George and the Droids Rights">{{WebCite|url=https://comicbook.com/starwars/2018/10/10/star-wars-solo-movie-l3-37-george-lucas|text=Star Wars: How George Lucas Influenced L3-37 in 'Solo'|author=Cavanaugh, Patrick|date=2018-10-09|archivedate=20190621031743}}</ref>

Droids Rights activists first make an appearance in the novel "''The Courtship of Princess Leia''" written in 1994.
